The types of AI systems banned under Article 5 of the AI Act due to unacceptable risks include:

1. AI systems that use subliminal techniques to influence behavior in a way that causes or may cause physical or psychological harm (Art. 5(1)(a)).
2. AI systems that exploit vulnerabilities of certain groups (due to age, physical or mental disability) to significantly influence behavior, causing or potentially causing harm (Art. 5(1)(b)).
3. AI systems for evaluating or classifying natural persons based on social behavior or personality characteristics that lead to detrimental treatment (social scoring) (Art. 5(1)(c)).
4. Real-time biometric remote identification systems in publicly accessible areas for law enforcement purposes, with specific exceptions (Art. 5(1)(d)).
